investigation_notes.Description: A single user performed an elevated volume of SharePoint downloads (550 files vs a 24-hour baseline of 120) from an engineering project repository. The activity originated from Tallinn, Estonia at 16:45 local time, used a standard Chrome user agent, and the accessed files are code-related (e.g., .py, requirements.txt), which aligns with the user's role in Engineering. There are no recent related events or similar alerts, and the user's role and department provide a plausible business justification for bulk access, so this activity is assessed as low priority despite the higher-than-baseline file count.
